changes.complete: Complete file listing and blob-by-blob comparison
changes.impact_fallback: Dependency coverage is unknown or the material exceeds one bounded review. Full semantic analysis is required.
changes.incomplete: The baseline, target manifest, or file versions are incomplete.
changes.no_baseline: First scan or no compatible manifest
changes.prompt_scope: The report includes the full file-by-file diff. This request includes counts and changes related to the current claims. Draw conclusions only for the changes shown.
changes.unknown_impact: The affected scope could not be confirmed. Full semantic analysis is required.
changes.unverified_history: The branch changed, history is discontinuous, or the provider could not verify ancestry.
checkpoint.language_changed: Saved analysis stages have a different language. Cancel this run and start a full scan. Saved progress is retained.
coverage.legacy_files_truncated: Some files were read only in part. Citations cover the lines actually read.
coverage.legacy_read: This review read {read} of {eligible} eligible files. Unread files are outside the scope of its conclusions.
coverage.legacy_tree_truncated: The file listing was truncated, so the eligible file count covers only the listed portion.
coverage.partial_preview: These module observations have been saved. The full report and candidate review are still pending.
coverage.partial_saved: Some modules or sections are incomplete. Completed stages are saved. The full report is still pending.
coverage.read_only: This report uses read-only source analysis. It did not install dependencies or run tests. Personal contributions are unconfirmed.
normalization: Sparse NUL characters in {count} UTF-8 source files were escaped reversibly for display. Original line numbers, character coordinates, escape mappings, and redacted source hashes are retained. Display escapes do not establish what the original code spelled out or whether it runs correctly.
paths.complete: This lists all paths eligible for analysis at the pinned revision. Paths excluded by policy are omitted.
paths.normalization_note: The normalizations table identifies control characters escaped reversibly for display. Line numbers are preserved. Use the recorded coordinates to distinguish display escapes from literal characters in the original source.
paths.omitted.dependencies: Dependency entries outside the eligible paths at this revision: {count}. The dependency scope remains unconfirmed.
paths.omitted.read_requests: Read requests outside the eligible paths at this revision: {count}. The dependency scope remains unconfirmed.
paths.partial: This is a partial list of eligible paths. Other eligible files may exist.
quarantine: Independent source review {review_id} excluded a disputed model claim from the report's facts and memory candidates. Original review reason: {reason} The original claim and its source citations are available for inspection. The claim remains unresolved.
reuse: The module and its explicit dependencies have matching blobs, policy, model configuration, and language.
section.tests_deploy: Tests and deployment in the source
